newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 2.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN
- Government to build 12,000 low cost homes in Abidjan, following cabinet decision last Thursday. LA VOIE
- Saturday's march of opposition Ivorian Popular Front youth wing to support protesting students won little support

- Plans for local production of liquid petroleum gas bottles for domestic use further advanced in neighbouring Ghana than in Ivory Coast, where such bottles are in short supply. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
